## Combo 3263-3698-6871--211
Cards: Toph, the First Metalbender + Grinding Station + Mycosynth Lattice
Color identity: RGW | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 380 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite mill; Infinite self-mill; Infinite artifact ETB; Infinite artifact LTB; Infinite artifact sacrifice triggers; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers
Requires: Creature with ETB: Earthbend (hand)
Start: Toph, the First Metalbender (battlefield); Grinding Station (battlefield); Mycosynth Lattice (battlefield)
Prerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
Steps: Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
  When the creature enters, it and Grinding Station trigger.
  Resolve the creature's trigger, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
  Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
  Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the earthbent creature.
  When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
  Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 5, causing a player to mill three cards
  Repeat from step 5.
